glossary.definition: A list of numbers representing text or an image so that similar meanings get nearby vectors.
The cosine of the angle between two vectors: 1 means same direction, 0 unrelated.
A passage a document is split into before embedding.
A model that embeds query and document separately; fast because document vectors are precomputed.
A model that reads query and document together to score relevance; accurate but slow.
Inverse document frequency: rarer terms get more weight in keyword ranking.
A keyword ranking function using term frequency, IDF and document length.
Hypothetical Document Embeddings: embed an LLM-written sample answer instead of the question.
A model trained on image–caption pairs so text and images share one vector space.
A wrong result that looks very like the right one; valuable for training.
Embeddings trained so the first dimensions hold the most information, allowing truncation.
Storing numbers in fewer bits, such as float32 → int8 or 1 bit, to save memory.
Share of relevant items that appear in the top k results.
Mean reciprocal rank: the average of 1 ÷ rank of the first relevant result.
Rewriting text from one script to another without translating it, such as “paisa” to “पैसा”.
Search where the query and the document are in different languages, such as a Hindi question finding an English article.
The average number of tokens a tokenizer produces per word; it is usually higher for Devanagari than for English.
The part of a test set in one language, evaluated and reported on its own.
Retrieval that keeps one vector per token and compares query and document tokens at search time.
The late-interaction score: for each query token take its highest similarity to any document token, then sum.
A late-interaction model that embeds patches of page images, so documents can be searched without OCR.

symptomRouter.symptom: Users ask in their own words, not our terminology
symptomRouter.advice: Embed chunks and queries with a dense model and search by similarity.

symptomRouter.symptom: Queries include error codes, SKUs or names
symptomRouter.advice: Keep a BM25 index so exact rare terms rank first, ideally fused with vectors.

symptomRouter.symptom: We need to search images, slides or scans
symptomRouter.advice: Use a multimodal model so text and images share one vector space.

symptomRouter.symptom: Off-the-shelf embeddings miss our domain’s jargon
symptomRouter.advice: Fine-tune with contrastive pairs and hard negatives from your own data.

symptomRouter.symptom: The vector index is too big or too slow
symptomRouter.advice: Truncate or quantize vectors, then re-rank with full precision.

symptomRouter.symptom: Customers write in Hindi or Hinglish and search misses them
symptomRouter.advice: Use a multilingual embedding model, transliterate Roman Hindi, and measure recall for each language separately.

symptomRouter.symptom: Scanned forms and tables are hard to search, or single vectors miss details
symptomRouter.advice: Late interaction: ColBERT for text, ColPali for page images, with a compressed index.
